name: config-attach-daemon-opens
description: Default launch (no --no-daemon: a daemon plus an attached window) in a throwaway HOME. The attached terminal still opens the /config modal (the web-transport guard against fullscreen views must not refuse them in an attach client), and a slider change saved to Global persists in $HOME/.kollab/config.json. The hub stays enabled because the daemon-first launch requires it (cli._should_use_daemon -> _hub_is_enabled); isolation is the throwaway HOME, which holds the presence files, sockets and network state. Keys go one per 0.5 s (paste detection eats faster input).

teardown.description: stop the daemon this launch forked (hub CLI of the throwaway HOME only)
teardown.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-config-attach-daemon"; cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub stop all
